'''Merritt Rineld''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] of [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He opposed the ruling king of Dubrillion, [[Actavarus III]], and sought to reinstall the [[Drayen dynasty]] to the throne by marrying [[Risha Drayen]].

Some time before the [[sacking of Dubrillion]], he was assassinated by the King.<ref name="KotET" />
